test: Package-specific account visibility in the connected Westlake account adapter

signedApkEvidence.scope: Static paths in the signed original APK. This fixture does not identify which path Gmail used.

implementation: The official Play services APK contains separate Android calls for its own account list and for accounts visible to a named package. Westlake’s connected account adapter now checks the target of a package-specific request. An app can query its own granted account. A request for another app requires the existing live account-picker selection, and a remote request must match the picker’s connection. The system-only account query is refused for broker clients running as apps.
interpretation: A test fixture in the original Gmail process on OpenHarmony used Android AccountManager. The ordinary Google account query and the all-types query for Gmail each returned one account. The absent package and the unrelated account type each returned zero. The system-only query raised SecurityException. The original Gmail Primary view displayed the same mailbox region as before. These five API checks do not establish a fresh Gmail account selection or receipt of the test message.
limits: The five requests were made by the regression fixture inside the original Gmail process. They are separate from Gmail’s own startup requests.
An active authorized account picker for a different package and concurrent callers were not exercised by this fixture.
The fix applies to the connected broker client path. Gmail delivery, durable cross-app account visibility, and complete Android AccountManager parity remain open.
